scope: Global notification visual renderer plus structured important-event policy; native routing is not yet migrated
reference: ../app/index.html?notification-review=1; index.html and history.html resolve to this shared host

action.width: content plus padding, bounded by footer

overflow: Single-line title, source, object and detail when a result action exists; full original strings retained. Messages without a result action preserve wrapped detail.
verification: Native local scenario fixture calls production host publish functions and presenter; no remote operation is executed. See verification/report.json.
platformDifferences: Native SVG icons and system text shaping; HTML uses CSS and text symbols. Card dimensions and control sizes are matched in logical pixels.
metadata: Source and object share a single ellipsized line, joined by ·; identical labels are deduplicated.

policy.globalAdmission: allowed kind + actual actionable impact + time sensitivity + source not viewed; application risk exception
policy.history: only admitted important events; pending vs recent; read != resolved
policy.nativeStatus: visual baseline retained; routing/center-state migration pending
